svg.text: Dev deployment on AWS, and the people and tools outside it. As deployed on 5 October 2026.
No NAT gateway: the services reach
Sign-in, private AWS access through a VPC endpoint, or admin access

The four services pull their images from ECR and write logs to CloudWatch through the VPC endpoints; ECS injects the database credentials from Secrets Manager at task start. Those links are not drawn. The release scripts also upload the two sites to the S3 site buckets.
